items.title: Joe Harris Interview, 1961-04-12
items.q: Forty Hours playing Gittor. That was Forty Hours band.

ctx.x: That's from here. We had the band at Chinatown. We had the little band at Chinatown. Where was that? That's on Ethan LaSalle. Forty Hours playing?
Forty Hours playing Gittor. That was Forty Hours band.

Yeah. That's the little band. I never did mention all the little short bands. That was one of them. Then we had Henry Russ. Ray McCormick. He was playing that bass or drums? He was playing drums. See, Russ didn't even got all the drums, he was playing trumpet. Trumpet player, drum player, now he's playing bass.
